sites.name: Example Heritage Site
story: This is an example site added via the remote content feed. Replace with real heritage content.
Photo is served from an external URL — no base64 required. The app fetches it from the CDN at display time.
Set 'bp' to true if this site has a HASA Blue Plaque.
